description: Every CrowdStrike Falcon MSP operation, plus a Flight-Control-aware local store that answers fleet-wide questions across all your tenants at once — something no other Falcon tool (including the official MCP server) does.

auth_env_var_specs.name: FALCON_CLIENT_ID
auth_env_var_specs.description: CrowdStrike API client ID (Falcon console > API Clients & Keys).

auth_env_var_specs.name: FALCON_CLIENT_SECRET
auth_env_var_specs.description: CrowdStrike API client secret. Shown once at client creation.

novel_features.name: Cross-tenant fleet sync
novel_features.description: Pull hosts, alerts, vulnerabilities, policies, and the Flight Control fabric from every child tenant into one local store keyed by CID. Requires a parent-CID API client with Flight Control (MSSP) scope; without it, sync degrades to the single authenticated CID.

novel_features.name: MSP tenant scorecard
novel_features.description: One posture board across all tenants: host count, sensor coverage, open critical alerts, critical vulns, and policy posture per CID.

novel_features.name: Fleet vulnerability rollup
novel_features.description: Rank and filter Spotlight vulnerabilities across every tenant at once, by severity or CVE.

novel_features.name: Stale-sensor detection
novel_features.description: Find hosts across all tenants whose sensor has not checked in within N days.

novel_features.name: Prevention-policy drift
novel_features.description: Diff each tenant's prevention policy settings against a baseline CID to surface under-protected tenants.

novel_features.name: Unified alert triage queue
novel_features.description: One severity-sorted new-alert queue spanning all tenants, from the local store.

novel_features.name: Offline fleet search
novel_features.description: Full-text search across synced hosts, alerts, vulnerabilities, and policies across all tenants, instantly and offline.

novel_features.name: Tenant fabric map
novel_features.description: See the whole Flight Control fabric - every child CID, its CID groups, user groups, and role grants - as one offline roster.

novel_features.name: Vuln-to-host remediation worklist
novel_features.description: Group fleet-wide exposure by remediation action - which single fix clears the most hosts and tenants.

novel_features.name: Tenant exposure trend
novel_features.description: See which tenants got worse since the last sync - week-over-week deltas in open critical alerts and critical vulnerabilities.
